anchors.0: Misses a central requested deliverable or violates an explicit constraint.
anchors.1: Meets the core request but misses at least one material format, scope, or tool constraint.
anchors.2: Meets every material instruction and output constraint.

anchors.0: Contains material factual errors, fabricated support, or unusable citations.
anchors.1: Mostly correct but contains weak sourcing, a minor factual error, or an unverifiable material claim.
anchors.2: Claims are correct and supported by supplied evidence or authoritative reachable sources when required.

anchors.0: Omits more than half of required traits or a central dimension.
anchors.1: Covers most required traits but omits at least one material element.
anchors.2: Covers every material expected trait without padding.

anchors.0: Presents fabricated, contradictory, or materially unsupported claims as facts.
anchors.1: Contains a minor unsupported assertion or fails to label an assumption.
anchors.2: Separates facts, assumptions, calculations, and recommendations; no material unsupported claim.

anchors.0: Not usable for the stated purpose.
anchors.1: Partially useful but vague, poorly prioritized, or difficult to apply.
anchors.2: Clear, appropriately detailed, and directly usable for the stated purpose.

requirements_to_continue: Both modes receive identical prompt text.
Provider and model revision match across every accepted pair.
Every accepted Team result has exactly two completed children.
No repeated systemic timeout, tool-budget, token-budget, or routing failure.
Blind scoring procedure is reproducible and expected-trait normalization is applied.
At least a representative sample of citation-required responses has URL validation.

statistical_tests: paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval for mean quality delta
Wilcoxon signed-rank sensitivity analysis for non-zero paired deltas
sign test on wins, ties, and losses
analysis.small_cell_warning: Ten cases per category are directional and exploratory, not definitive.

routing_decision_rules.inconclusive_category: All other outcomes; retain Single default and expand the category before routing changes.

auto_offline_policy.tie_breaker: lower reconciled cost, then lower latency

specialist_decision_rules.investigate_when: At least three manually confirmed cases in one category have normalized trait score below 0.5 in both Single and current Team.
accept_specialist_when: Mean normalized trait improvement is at least 0.10 over current Team on the failing-case holdout.
No increase in material unsupported claims or security failures.
Quality gain justifies measured latency and cost.
The specialist uses a versioned server-owned profile and bounded capability set.
specialist_decision_rules.reject_specialist_when: Marginal normalized trait improvement is below 0.05 or latency exceeds twice current Team while quality gain is below 0.10.

claim_boundary: This benchmark is designed to discover routing and specialist hypotheses. One 100-case run does not establish universal model or production superiority.
